input.rationale: Section 12.1.1 lists SFJ's indemnity heads (gross negligence/wilful misconduct, material breach, Protocol breach, AZ License breach, post-transfer injury and product liability) but contains no third-party intellectual-property indemnity anywhere in the Agreement. Conversely, Section 12.1.2(f) makes PB indemnify SFJ for infringement of Third Party Intellectual Property "by either Party in performing its duties or obligations hereunder" — a one-way IP indemnity running to the counterparty, which is our walk-away position. The Article 12.2 procedure (notice, control of defence, cooperation) is already adequate and unchanged. We therefore target the fallback: an SFJ IP indemnity with the customary PB modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure-modify-replace-refund remedies and a 3x super-cap, plus a conforming cut to 12.1.2(f) so PB no longer covers SFJ's own infringement. We did not pursue the preferred position (narrowing PB's indemnity to PB-supplied content and PB's breach of law) because it would require striking the negotiated subject-injury and product-liability heads in Sections 12.1.2(b)-(g), a collateral rewrite.

ops.text: SFJ will also indemnify the PB Indemnified Parties from any and all Losses arising or resulting from any Claim by a Third Party alleging that any services, materials or deliverables provided by SFJ or any of its Affiliates or Permitted Third Parties infringe or misappropriate the Intellectual Property of a Third Party, except to the extent such Claim arises from PB's modification of such items, PB's combination of such items with items not supplied by SFJ, or SFJ's compliance with PB's specifications. SFJ will procure for PB the right to continue using the infringing item, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, and if none of the foregoing is available on commercially reasonable terms, refund the amounts paid by PB to SFJ for such item. SFJ's liability under this paragraph will not exceed three (3) times the amounts paid or payable by PB to SFJ under this Agreement during the twelve (12) months preceding the Claim.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article 12 gives us no IP indemnity from SFJ and in fact makes us indemnify SFJ for infringement by either Party, which is our walk-away position; we have added an SFJ third-party IP indemnity with the usual PB modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace and refund remedies and a 3x super-cap. We have correspondingly limited Section 12.1.2(f) to infringement by the Product we supply.
proposal.summary: Add an SFJ third-party IP infringement indemnity with customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x super-cap, and stop PB indemnifying SFJ for SFJ's own infringement.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
